name: Koi junction
purpose: The corridor widens into a small round pond with black and gold koi under the mist and a bronze bell: a pause and a fork (north to the Mirror, west to the steam grotto and the Mist Steps).

ceiling_profile.note: Shallow carved dome, 3.5 m at the crown: a release after the 3 m corridors, still intimate.

hero.why: Lookbook: at junctions the corridor widens into ponds with koi. The pond sits in the quiet SW quarter, off the through-route, lit from below so the black and gold fish glow under the mist; it is the brightest, slowest thing here and it marks the fork.

anchored.why: Stone lantern on the pond's west rim, doubled in the pond; seen from the lobby mouth.
Leans over the pond's south rim; silhouette against the underwater glow.
Between the west branch and the north leg, facing the pond: on the right of the concept frame.
Pairs flanking the north mouth and the east mouth, one by the west mouth; none behind the pond so it stays the brightest.

water.note: Corridor pool continues through; same -20.05 surface.
A deeper well in the same pool (one surface); low rim stones at -20.00 mark its edge.

sightlines.see: Pond glow, toro and bell; the west branch opening on the left with steam light beyond.
Arriving from the grotto: the bell and the lantern-lined north leg rising away.
Returning from the Mirror: the pond and the warm lobby mouth to the east.

concept.match: Mood, not geometry: mist on water, stepping stones curving away left into the west branch, toro and pond glow lower left, bell frame on the right, warm steam-grotto light at the end.

dressing.why: Rim stones that break the surface (rocks in water now sit proud), marking the pond as a separate well.

mood.palette: warm-teal pond light, black and gold koi, amber niches, bronze bell
mood.mist: Knee-high (0.4 m) layer over the whole pool, densest at the walls, thinning over the stones. Slightly thicker over the pond.

waivers.reason: The hero sits at the water line (pond glow at -20.05, lip top -19.85); the graybox mist sheet 0.35 m above the water is solid in the visibility raycast and hides it. Reported to the lead; remove this waiver once mist is excluded.

light_notes_extra: Hero (koi_pond) now renders emissive with its own key light; toro (15 W) stays dimmer than the pond.
light_notes: koi_pond carries its own underwater light (assets.json light), the brightest point here.
conventions: anchored/hero 'at' = object centre on its floor; facing_deg = bearing of the asset's front (+Y). Extra keys beyond SCHEMA.md: spurs, segments, implied portals, bed_z/top_z, stagger/groups on lights, footprint on still water.
